'''Biddeck-Va''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss commandos|Voss Commando]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He possessed the [[Pendant of Bone]], the talisman that opened the doors to the [[Dark Heart|Hall of the Unforgotten]] in the [[Dark Heart]] of the [[Nightmare Lands]], though he was unaware of its importance. Around [[3640 BBY]] Biddeck-Va went on a mission to kill [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] chieftains in the [[Gormak Lands]], where he and Commando [[Ono-Mi]] set up a base. When the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] sought the audience with Biddeck-Va, Ono-Mi explained that his mission could last for months and he would not be available until it's over. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had no time to wait and simply slaughtered the Gormak chieftains all alone, to the surprise of both Ono-Mi and Biddeck-Va. Seeking the chance to gain valuable service for what he viewed as mere trinket, Biddeck-Va asked the Sith to slay the Gormak warmaster as well, but the Emperor's Wrath refused and instead killed him and the other Voss.<ref name="TOR" />
